purpose: Structured factual supplements for D&D 3.x item pages whose primary DnD Tools record omits gameplay-critical mechanics. Supplements fill missing fields only; conflicts fail validation.

items/saddle-of-speed-2-792.name: Saddle of Speed 2
items/saddle-of-speed-2-792.effectSummary: Enhances the wearer's speed as tier 2 of the Saddle of Speed family, equivalent to 2 applications of the 3.0 Speed of Thought feat; it can provide up to a +20-foot speed increase. The actual increase is limited by both the saddle's tier and the wearer's qualifying psionic reserve; a wearer with psionic powers but no psionic class instead uses the highest-level power held in reserve to determine the available family tier.
